name: Marrakech & Atlas
about: Spring (Mar–May) and fall (Sep–Nov) are ideal for souks and mountain trekking; summer inland heat is brutal for hiking.
overview: Red-walled medina alleys, Atlas Mountain day trips, and a design and luxury scene that punches well above the destination's everyday prices.
costOverview: Tea, taxis, and tagines cost almost nothing in the medina — the price gap to riads and hammams at the luxury end is enormous.
monthlyWeather: mild by day but cold at night, with the Atlas peaks capped in snow
